shortDescription: Saudi Arabia’s economy contracted again at a slower pace, leaving the kingdom on track for one of its worst economic performances in years even before a recent escalation in its conflict with the Houthis, according to Bloomberg.

title: Saudi Economy’s Contraction Eases Before Houthi Conflict Escalation
